intro.uz: Otabek oʻz futbol jamoasi haqida gapirib beradi. Oʻqishdan oldin oʻylab koʻring: siz qaysi sportni yoqtirasiz?

paragraphs.en: My name is Otabek. I am twelve years old. I love football. I play in a team at a sports school in Tashkent. Our team is called Yulduz.
paragraphs.uz: Mening ismim Otabek. Men oʻn ikki yoshdaman. Men futbolni juda yaxshi koʻraman. Men Toshkentdagi sport maktabida bir jamoada oʻynayman. Jamoamizning nomi «Yulduz».

paragraphs.en: We train three times a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Our coach is Mr Rustamov. He is kind but strict. We run, pass the ball and play short games.
paragraphs.uz: Biz haftasiga uch marta — dushanba, chorshanba va juma kunlari mashq qilamiz. Murabbiyimiz — Rustamov. U mehribon, lekin talabchan. Biz yuguramiz, toʻp oshiramiz va qisqa oʻyinlar oʻynaymiz.

paragraphs.en: I am a goalkeeper. I am tall and I can jump high. My friend Sardor is our captain. He can run very fast.
paragraphs.uz: Men darvozabonman. Men baland boʻyliman va baland sakray olaman. Doʻstim Sardor — jamoamiz sardori. U juda tez yugura oladi.

paragraphs.en: On Sunday we have a big match against a team from Yunusobod. I am a little nervous, but I am happy too. Come and watch us!
paragraphs.uz: Yakshanba kuni bizda Yunusoboddagi jamoaga qarshi katta oʻyin bor. Men biroz hayajondaman, lekin xursandman ham. Kelib bizni tomosha qiling!

questions.prompt: How often does the team train?

explain.uz: «We train three times a week» — dushanba, chorshanba va juma.
Murabbiy talabchan: «He is kind but strict.»

questions.prompt: What does Otabek do in the team?

explain.uz: «I am a goalkeeper.» Jamoa sardori (captain) esa — Sardor.
«He can run very fast.» — he = Sardor.

questions.prompt: On Sunday, the team plays against a team from ___.

explain.uz: «a big match against a team from Yunusobod».
